items.title: Michael Burry exits Nasdaq-100 short
items.summary: Michael Burry disclosed Wednesday that he had exited his Nasdaq-100 short by selling the last of his put options on the tech-heavy index, while keeping puts on Palantir Technologies Inc (NYSE:PLTR) and MetLife Inc (NYSE:MET). Burry did not disclose when he sold the options or how much he made...

items.title: Michael Burry sells remaining Nasdaq 100 puts, says portfolio is long
items.summary: Investing.com -- Michael Burry, the investor who famously bet against the U.S. housing market ahead of the 2008 financial crisis, has sold the remainder of his bearish Nasdaq 100 position, saying his portfolio is now temporarily almost entirely long amid heightened market volatility.
